candidate.name: MCL Exact Directional-Impulse Flipper Control
candidate.purpose: Measure the repository's actual product-neutral turn owner before inventing oil-specific gates

engine.entry_window_et: 00:00-23:59 excluding exchange closures through tape availability
engine.initial_state: observe_only; only a subsequent turn_event may open risk

bounded_cells.ranking: discovery eligibility, positive quarter count, worst-quarter primary and stress net, stress net/intrabar-DD, stress PF, then primary net; validation cannot select a cell

lifecycle.entry: next available MCL one-minute open after a completed CL turn, only when the latest completed MCL five-minute move confirms direction
lifecycle.opposite_turn: close then flip at the same next MCL one-minute open, charging a round trip to each completed trade
lifecycle.maintenance: retain position and state across the ordinary daily halt
lifecycle.roll: close the old active MCL contract at its last available close and reopen the same direction at the next matched contract open; cost both legs and reset CL turn state for the new suffix
lifecycle.stop_target_timeout: none in this exact flipper control
lifecycle.end_of_tape: close at the final MCL close

fixed_owners.roll: dual prior-session CL/MCL volume cross, forced three complete sessions before MCL expiry

successor_law: If this exact control fails, use its causal proposal/veto/MFE/MAE anatomy to preregister distinct oil-specific direction or permission profiles; never threshold-rescue it from outcomes.
prohibitions: no crown without the missing first challenge year
